JOURNEY TO THE MOON

Chapter 6 · On the Moon

You are down, in the valley of Taurus-Littrow. You stand at the Commander's station; the cabin is let down to vacuum and the hatch swings in. Out backwards on hands and knees, along the porch, feet first down the ladder, the drop to the footpad, the first step. Then the valley is yours to walk. Stand up for this chapter.

In the headset. Climbing out: grip and pull yourself along, or A and it goes by itself (A again stops). On the ground: the left stick walks (in hopping steps: a setting), the right stick turns, hold the right trigger to aim a jump and let go (from 10 m off the LM). Hold X to talk on the radio. By the front footpad a grip or a trigger takes you back up the ladder. Left stick press: the status and the settings.
On this screen: drag to look, F climbs out by itself, then WASD walk.
